hero.text: Discover thousands of opportunities tailored to your skills. Apply with ease, track your progress, and take the next step in your career — all in one place.
hero.talentText: Connect with skilled, flexible professionals who are ready to jump in.
hero.remoteText: Access a curated pool of adaptable professionals from around the globe.

categories.text: Easily navigate through job types to find what suits you best. Remote, hybrid, full-time and more — just a click away.
categories.remote: Work from anywhere in the EU and the UK with fully remote teams.
categories.hybrid: Split your week between home and the office.
categories.on_site: Join the team in person at their workplace.
categories.full_time: Permanent roles with a full working week.
categories.part_time: Flexible hours that fit around the rest of your life.
categories.contract: Fixed-term projects for specialists and freelancers.

steps.text: Skip the guesswork. With our step-by-step approach, finding and securing your ideal job has never been simpler.
steps.imageAlt: A job interview in a modern office
steps.registerText: Register your personal identity on this platform to access features.
steps.searchText: Look for job vacancies and immediately get your dream job.
steps.resumeText: Upload the latest resume to let recruiters know about work experience.
steps.applyText: Fill necessary details according to the job requirement and apply.
